Company logo, backup and database options

Company Logo

Yeh logo sidebar, dashboard aur har print report ke letterhead mein aata hai.

Backup & Restore

Poora data (batches, packing lists, production plan, transporter directory) ek file mein save karein. Computer badalne ya browser saaf karne se pehle backup zaroor lein.

Database Status

Data browser ke IndexedDB mein mehfooz hota hai (5 MB ki purani limit nahi).

Workers Mobile App

Workers apne mobile mein yeh link kholein (office WiFi se connected hon) ya QR scan karein, phir browser menu se "Add to Home screen" karein.

Reset Database

Tamam batches, packing lists, production plans aur transporter data hamesha ke liye delete ho jayega. Pehle backup le lein.
